references.text: God blessed them and said: Be fruitful and multiply, fill the waters in the seas, and let birds multiply on the earth.

God blessed them and said to them: Be fruitful and multiply, fill the earth and subdue it! Have dominion over the fish of the sea, the birds under heaven, and every living thing that moves on the earth.

They and all kinds of wild animals, all kinds of livestock, all kinds of creeping things that move on the earth, and all kinds of birds—everything with wings. They went into the ark to Noah, two by two from every kind of flesh in which was the breath of life.
God blessed Noah and his sons and said to them: Be fruitful and multiply and fill the earth.
But you shall be fruitful and multiply, increase on the earth and become many upon it.
He blesses them so that they become very numerous, and he does not let their livestock decrease.
